findings.description: The `include` narrowed to `['test/**/*.test.ts']`, but three test files still live under `src/adapters/` at HEAD (capability-utils, failing-tests, vitest-config-utils). They existed unchanged at base and the PR does not touch them. vitest no longer collects them, so 27 test cases stop running and no error is raised.
findings.body:
**Three `src/adapters` test files silently drop out of the run**

The `include` now covers `test/` only:

```ts
include: ['test/**/*.test.ts'],
```
<https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/da58cc17a7eb0553a37ef8464b8b4c2cb113e6ff/vitest.config.ts#L13-L13>

This PR moves only the `src/core` tests. Three test files are still under `src/adapters/` at HEAD, and the PR does not touch them:

- `src/adapters/vitest-config-utils.test.ts` covers `vitestCollection` and the root-files helpers.
- `src/adapters/failing-tests.test.ts` covers the `failingTests` parsing of vitest, jest and pytest summaries. The gate uses this parser to name a failed stage's tests.
- `src/adapters/capability-utils.test.ts` covers `readPlainFile`, including the decision-194 refusal of a store file with a second hard link (`soleLink: true`).

Together they hold 29 `it` call sites, several of them `it.each` tables. The new include does not collect any of them. Vitest raises no error when files fall outside `include`, so the suite still passes. The gate's `test: PASS` also ran under the narrowed include.

None of these cases is duplicated under `test/`:
- `test/unit/adapters/capability-utils.test.ts` does not have the `soleLink` hard-link cases.
- Nothing under `test/` tests `vitestCollection` or the adapters' `failingTests` parsing. `test/unit/adapters/typescript-adapter.test.ts:296` even says that logic is "tested there", meaning the `src/` file that no longer runs.

From now on, a regression in the hard-link guard, the failing-test parser or the vitest-config reader ships with a green suite.

**Fix:** move the three files into `test/unit/adapters/` before narrowing `include`, and rewrite their `./` imports to `@src/adapters/...`. Fold the `readPlainFile` cases into the existing `test/unit/adapters/capability-utils.test.ts`. Alternatively, keep `'src/**/*.test.ts'` in `include` until a follow-up moves them.
